correctness.rationale: The strict time-coordinate order is antisymmetric and transitive by transitivity of R. The principal up-set intersects a saturated B-fibre set infinitely iff an R-successor lies in B, because then the entire infinite tail of that successor is present; otherwise the intersection is at most a singleton. Boolean inverse-image preservation gives all formulas and transfinite iterates. Converse well-foundedness rules out any P subset omega(P) by choosing a terminal projected point; failure yields P subset omega(P), and the closed C=omega(P) is also omega-perfect. K4/GL restricted completeness follows by lifting standard finite transitive/irreflexive countermodels and Montacute soundness. Exhaustive finite frame/profile test: 4180 frames, 259828 profiles. Infinite part justified by proof, not by computation.

value.rationale: The construction answers a concrete semantic realizability question prompted by the new omega-accumulation modality: which transitive modal theories and scatteredness types are achievable on the minimal countable Alexandrov T0 class? It provides a uniform formula-preserving representation, a structural iff scatteredness criterion, transfinite compatibility, and sharply restricted K4/GL completeness that broad metrizable completeness alone does not imply. The fibre restriction is intrinsic and explicitly disclosed.
